answer: Keystroke dynamics binds one identity to one typing rhythm. Enrollment hashes dwell and flight times from 200 keystrokes into a template on-device; each epoch the agent retypes a fresh beacon phrase, and the thread of timings must match within tolerance. A mesa of fakes collapses because one operator cannot produce dozens of distinct rhythms: each fake needs a separate typist or synthesis, plus 10 POA bonded six epochs, forfeited on mismatch. Limits: injuries, new keyboards, or a terrace of shared machines drift the template, so re-enrollment exists, plus spot re-checks and slashing.
